narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms developed across northeastern Oklahoma during the early morning hours of the 2nd, as a strong upper level disturbance approached the area from the west. The air mass across the region was very moist, which supported locally heavy rainfall in the thunderstorms, and some localized flash flooding.
ev: Locally heavy rainfall that fell in a short period of time resulted in portions of a number of roads flooding in the City of Tulsa. Some of the reported flooded areas included: S Sheridan Road near E 44th Street S, and E 32nd Street S; S Memorial Drive near Skelly Drive, and E 14th Street S; and S Boston Avenue near E 15th Street S. Several vehicles were stranded in high water in these areas, necessitating swift water rescues of the drivers.
